DEBUG: Safari fresh-launch overlays blocking Maestro keyboard activation

SYMPTOM: activate-keyboard.yaml fails on fresh simulators — 'Type here' input not found, keyboard never activates

CAUSE: Safari on fresh sims shows two sequential overlays:
1. First-launch welcome screen with 'Continue' button
2. 'View Bookmarks' tooltip that appears AFTER 'Continue' is dismissed — blocks the input field

FIX in activate-keyboard.yaml:
```yaml
- runFlow:
    when:
      visible: "Continue"
    file: helpers/dismiss-safari-welcome.yaml
- tapOn:
    point: "73%,8%"  # X button of View Bookmarks tooltip
- extendedWaitUntil:
    visible: "Type here"
    timeout: 8000
```

PREVENT: All keyboard tests that open Safari on fresh sims need this overlay-dismissal pattern. The 'Continue' check fires too early — the 'View Bookmarks' tooltip appears ~1s later.
